reason: A host-integrated DeepSeek chat plugin that adds an independent draggable and resizable conversation panel, supports quoting selected text, model switching, and streamed responses through the host's configured LLM service.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 中提供独立的 DeepSeek 悬浮聊天面板，支持引用主会话文本、切换模型和流式查看回复。
summaries.en: Adds an independent floating DeepSeek chat panel to the dsh Web UI with selected-text quoting, model switching, and streamed responses.

capabilities: Provides an independent DeepSeek chat panel inside the host web UI
Sends prompts and optionally selected conversation text through the host's configured LLM route
Supports streaming responses and reasoning display
Stores the selected model preference in localStorage
Registers local HTTP routes for chat, model selection, and plugin uninstall operations
